term: surplus goodness and omitted due goodness
definition: SurplusGood f means ∃ x p, GoodIn x p ∧ ¬DueActuality f x p. OmittedDueGood f means ∃ x p, DueActuality f x p ∧ ¬GoodIn x p. The structural fork covers exact coextension or at least one such counterexample, under explicit excluded middle.
note: Cells characterize deviations from the proposed extension and can overlap, as mixedArtifact verifies. Defeating both is equivalent to the extensional thesis under excluded middle; the fork supplies no independent philosophical reason to defeat them. Named schools need not occupy only one cell.
